closure_unit.outcome: Independent evidence proves delivered Vulkan-backed UI and all affected original three-WP workflows; held cases remain open until original proof passes.

materialized_acceptance.text: AC202-1: Use MT-197 all-contract coverage to preserve every original WP012/CKC/WP1 workflow, source pin, runtime/auth/deployment/privacy case and independent verdict. Reuse accepted unchanged coverage only with identical relevant inputs; new UI records cannot count as original runtime completion.

AC202-2: Distinct workflow tester tries real actions and multi-step editor/CKC/PoseKit/orchestration workflows, context changes/handoffs, keyboard/focus/IME, DPI/resize/multiwindow, icons/scrollbars/materials/type/readability/accessibility and empty/loading/error/denied/recovery.

AC202-3: Prove touching no-gutter panes/shared resize dividers, actual native Handpick mounting and genuine Vulkan backend/device/frames on exact admitted app inputs. Neither a prototype nor fallback renderer is sufficient.

AC202-4: Update affected built-in UserManual and stable model controls/headless/parallel routes. Preserve diagnostics, Argus/AccessKit, Flight Recorder, quiet operation and actor/scope privacy. A no-context model can operate affected workflows through documented routes.

AC202-5: Original named independent acceptance owner executes genuine runtime acceptance under actual current permission/allowance/admission. Preserve exact historical spent outcomes. Future relevant retries require current human scoped technical-leader and distinct independent-partner agreement; no reset/refill/automatic grant or invented numeric denial. Missing required proof remains unresolved.

AC202-6: Workflow tester and independent acceptance route prove module/feature Settings hierarchy discovery, Engine Profiles inside Settings/full dispatch, typed persistence and error/denied/recovery paths in the actual app. Prove Vulkan device/backend identity plus centralized GPU allocation/budget/pressure/staging/shared-versus-dedicated/inflight/reclaim/shutdown/device-loss/recovery/multiwindow/module attachment behavior on exact admitted inputs. Scope focused checks to real owning contracts, reusing unchanged proof.

AC202-7: Prove genuine new GUI diagnostic events and Vulkan/GPU memory/lifetime failures are observable through internal_diagnostics and retained as real correlated events by STANDALONE OUT-OF-PROCESS Palmistry after a controlled owned Handshake Product crash. This is later separately admitted through Primary/original independent acceptance route; no OS crash, foreign stop, automatic restart, recovery execution or model authority. Reuse unaffected original diagnostic/source proof and preserve normal lifecycle/owned drain. Bind existing stable event/control IDs, real correlation/session and exact target PID/process-birth identity. Normal explicit shutdown requires its actual acknowledgements and owned drain; no later-empty-process proxy.

When Handshake needs missing reusable GUI logic, extend the declared canonical Kumihimo original source and reusable public capability FIRST; perform focused owning source proof, normal canonical publication and independent exact remote reread before distinct immutable pinned Handshake host adoption. Consume adequate existing capability without compulsory source changes. No host-local workaround, copied private implementation or host-only fork; host-specific policy/adaptation stays in Handshake under HBR-MODULE-LIFECYCLE-004/007/008.

GUI work MUST follow current build rules using small focused crates/modules with independently selectable source/dependency/build/test/artifact closures and focused typed clients, without large aggregate/sink crates. Bind each implementation MT to its actual owning logical module or existing build unit and respect dependency direction and actual project build budgets under HBR-COMPART-001/002 and HBR-MODULE-LIFECYCLE-001. Preserve the conditional applicability of crate-based rebuild accounting; invent no numerical cap, forced crate split, blanket refactor or all-project hold.
